summary: Keep Immich personal-library workflows statically discoverable and conservative: command wiring matches runtime help, destructive choices require reviewed evidence, and partial transfers cannot silently lose uploaded assets or collection members.
reason: The extension hook hid valid command edges from the shipped verifier, while review found safety gaps around inferred duplicate keepers, upload partial success, stale duplicate evidence, and malformed or partially mapped collection migration.
validated_outcome: verify_skill.py --strict resolves the novel command paths; focused regression tests cover evidence-locked explicit duplicate keepers, retained upload IDs and album assignment, and all source collections prevalidated before malformed or partially mapped data can mutate the destination.
